StoreCatalog.title: StoreCatalog
StoreCatalog.description: Public store categories, icons, accent colors, and chunk metadata synced in real time.

ecat.description: Ordered list of category emojis matching cats.

colors.description: Ordered list of hex accent colors matching cats.

chunkCount.description: Number of catalog_chunks documents currently active (1-20).

productCount.description: Total number of products across all chunks.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last catalog publish.

updatedBy.description: UID of the authorized admin who updated the catalog.

CatalogChunk.title: CatalogChunk
CatalogChunk.description: Bounded batch of up to 100 products using image URLs or fbimg:// references (zero raw Base64 blobs in catalog chunks).

items.description: Bounded list of product objects (<= 100 items).

updatedBy.description: UID of the authorized admin who wrote the chunk.

ProductImage.title: ProductImage
ProductImage.description: Compressed product photo uploaded by admin and referenced via fbimg://{imageId} link from catalog chunks.

mime.description: MIME type of the compressed product photo.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when photo was uploaded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last photo update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the authorized admin who uploaded the photo.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized admin user record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

AdminEmailEntry.title: AdminEmailEntry
AdminEmailEntry.description: Authorized admin Google email allowlist entry keyed by lowercase email.

active.description: Whether this email is authorized for admin login.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when email entry was added.

AdminAuthSecret.title: AdminAuthSecret
AdminAuthSecret.description: Private second-factor admin password hash stored exclusively in Firestore.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of 'esd-market:' + admin password.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin password hash was updated.

updatedBy.description: UID of the authorized admin who updated the password hash.

/store/{docId}.description: Public store metadata document (/store/catalog); readable by visitors, writable only by verified admins.

/catalog_chunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked product catalog documents (/catalog_chunks/chunk_0..chunk_19); readable by visitors, writable only by verified admins.

/product_images/{imageId}.description: Compressed product images referenced by fbimg://{imageId} links; individual doc readable by visitors, writable/deletable only by verified admins.

/admins/{uid}.description: UID-keyed admin roster; readable only by owner UID or another admin.

/admin_emails/{emailId}.description: Lowercase email allowlist for Google Sign-In; individual doc readable only by matching verified email or admin.

/store_private/{docId}.description: Admin password hash (/store_private/admin_auth); strictly restricted to verified admins.
